name: Coding Tools
description: Native coding tools (FILE, SHELL, WORKTREE) running directly in the agent. Commands are analyzed before trusted host execution; mtime-gated file writes and configured path roots apply to FILE, WORKTREE, and the SHELL working directory.

CODING_TOOLS_WORKSPACE_ROOTS.label: Workspace roots
CODING_TOOLS_WORKSPACE_ROOTS.help: Comma-separated absolute roots for FILE and WORKTREE paths and the SHELL working directory. SHELL commands may address paths outside these roots. Defaults to the runtime's cwd.

CODING_TOOLS_DENY_COMMANDS.label: Forbidden command patterns
CODING_TOOLS_DENY_COMMANDS.help: Comma-separated regex patterns the SHELL action must refuse. Combined with the built-in denylist and AST analyzer.

CODING_TOOLS_SHELL_TIMEOUT_MS.label: Shell timeout
CODING_TOOLS_SHELL_TIMEOUT_MS.help: Default SHELL timeout in milliseconds. Must be a canonical decimal integer from 100 through 600000; invalid values fail before execution.

CODING_TOOLS_SHELL_BG_BUDGET_MS.label: Foreground budget
CODING_TOOLS_SHELL_BG_BUDGET_MS.help: Shell invocations exceeding this auto-background and return a task_id.
